areas: cart state integrity after rejected update

tests.what: PATCH /api/cart/:productId with qty 0 returns 400 with an {error} field, and a follow-up GET /api/cart returns exactly the same items array and subtotal/tax/total values captured before the rejected call

PATCH /api/cart/:productId with a negative qty (e.g. -1) returns 400 with an {error} field, and a follow-up GET /api/cart shows the cart snapshot (items and totals fields) identical to the pre-call state

plan.reason: Contract explicitly specifies qty<=0 -> 400 with cart unchanged at API level, but a seeded bug here could let negative quantities corrupt subtotal/tax/total downstream, and cart UI hooks are not fully visible in the provided contract so coverage is API-level only.
